Authenticates and obtains a JSON Web Token (JWT)
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/auth/v1/login

Authenticate using the apikey and the secretKey. The response returns a JSON Web Token (JWT), which must be used for authentication against other API calls in subsequent requests.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
apiKey
string

API key ID.

secretKey
string

Client secret.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
jwtToken
string

JSON Web Token (JWT).

message
string

API login message.
